# Functional documentation

What aussiefy does, as reference: every command, option, dial, data file and API, and what each one
guarantees. So anyway, for step\-by\-step guides, see the [user layer](../user/README.md); for how it works inside, the
[architecture layer](../architecture/README.md).

## Inline and co-located documentation

- **Module docstrings.** Each module in `aussiefy/` opens with a docstrin' saying what it does; public functions
  and classes document their behaviour. `aussiefy/__init__.py` summarises the Python API, and
  `aussiefy/harness.py` the toolkit.
- **Data file headers.** The YAML files in `aussiefy/data/` explain their own fields in header comments
  (for example `aussiefy/data/profiles.yaml`).
- **The agent skill.** [skills/aussiefy/SKILL.md](../../skills/aussiefy/SKILL.md) is the toolkit's usage
  contract for agents, including what each lint issue means.

## Tests as behavioural specification

The tests are executable specifications, organised by primary owner in the [test indexes](../../tests/README.md).
Fair dinkum, how to run them is in the
[contributor layer](../contributor/testing.md).

| Test module | Behaviour it pins |
|---|---|
| `tests/functional/test_engine.py` | The engine: detection, selection, realisation, garnish, drawl and the dials |
| `tests/functional/test_document_policy.py` | Document presets, exact overrides and shared-surface behaviour |
| `tests/functional/test_document_refinement.py` | Sentence-safe flavour, contractions, casing and technical-example fidelity |
| `tests/functional/test_smart_performance.py` | Semantic fallback eligibility, exact scores and complete-result parity |
| `tests/functional/test_profile_overrides.py` | Inherited advanced defaults, isolated controls and cross-surface configuration |
| `tests/functional/test_sense_boundaries.py` | Person/adjective sense limits and clothing agreement |
| `tests/functional/test_lookup_senses.py`, `tests/functional/test_harness_reliability.py` | Slot/sense lookup, phrase locality and data-driven lint comparisons |
| `tests/functional/test_markdown_composition.py` | Document-wide garnish and source sentence boundaries |
| `tests/functional/test_matching.py` | Tokenising, the pattern language and concept detection |
| `tests/functional/test_schema.py` | Dictionary loading and validation |
| `tests/architecture/test_golden.py` | Exact outputs per input, level and seed (`tests/corpus/golden.yaml`) |
| `tests/functional/test_reference.py` | Properties over public-domain texts: sense accuracy, hit rates, well-formed output, the benchmark |
| `tests/functional/test_everyday_reference.py` | Bounded repeatability and source integrity over all committed everyday inputs |
| `tests/functional/test_local_reference.py` | The same well-formedness checks on local copyrighted texts (skipped when there are none) |
| `tests/functional/test_harness.py` | The toolkit operations (lookup, lint, guide, plan), and the yarn loop against a scripted client, including its cache and fallback |
| `tests/functional/test_contracts.py` | The shapes agents consume: each operation's result, the yarn core, and rules other modules lean on |
| `tests/functional/test_interfaces.py` | Every surface exposes and forwards the same parameters by the same names and defaults |
| `tests/user/test_cli.py`, `tests/user/test_cli_boundaries.py` | Every subcommand through `main()`: exit codes, output and user-named file boundaries |
| `tests/contributor/test_docs.py` | Current documented command syntax through the real parser, and exact displayed CLI outputs |
| `tests/functional/test_guide.py` | Dial-gated craft, shared workflow and validated style-guide data |
| `tests/functional/test_llm.py` | Fluent surface and sentence rewrites against scripted clients, including their fallbacks, and the Claude client boundary |
| `tests/functional/test_claude.py` | The shared SDK request shape, prompt caching, failure classification and reply-cache errors |
| `tests/architecture/test_layers.py` | The package layering: the engine and dictionary import nothing from the layers above |
| `tests/user/test_models.py`, `tests/architecture/test_static.py` | Which embedding model is used and how it is installed, and the bundled static model's tokenizer, vectors and senses |
| `tests/functional/test_gaps.py` | Gap finding |
| `tests/contributor/test_scrape.py`, `tests/contributor/test_harvest.py`, `tests/contributor/test_rounds.py`, `tests/contributor/test_rounds_preservation.py` | The `dev` pipeline: scraping, fragments and harvesting, and research rounds |
| `tests/contributor/test_staging.py` | Staging format, YAML output, source policy and saved-page handling |
| `tests/contributor/test_notices.py` | Tracked provenance, generated notices and actual wheel contents |
| `tests/contributor/test_fetch_interfold.py` | Pinned local MDX acquisition, cache replay and interrupted-save recovery |
| `tests/contributor/test_fetch_reference.py` | Fetching and cutting the local reference texts |
| `tests/contributor/test_train_embedder.py` | Trainer recipe option placement, usage errors and help |
| `tests/contributor/test_promote.py` | Semver/changelog rules, strict PR enforcement and resumable local release cycles |
